about_the_game:
Back From Earth: Demo is a free taste of the full experience.
Follow Blip-Blop, a fragile and lost little alien, through the first planets of their journey home: a symbolic path through pain and descent that precede rebirth.

This demo lets you experience the initial stages of the game, with unique mechanics, minimalist yet evocative environments, and the emotional storm that begins the story.
It is designed to let you breathe the atmosphere and soul of Back From Earth before the full experience.

Each level is part of Blip-Blop’s inner journey, a reflection of their pain and slow healing.
The soundtrack follows every moment, amplifying emotions and symbolism.

This version is short, but it leaves a mark: it is the beginning of the journey.

The complete experience awaits you to discover all planets, the Real Lore Fragments, and the truth behind Blip-Blop’s rebirth.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: glibc 2.31+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 460 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey)
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel Core i7-8700K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Integrated GPU / AMD Radeon Pro 5500M
  • Storage: 460 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: You may see a "32-bit application" warning when launching the game. This is a false macOS warning caused by missing notarization. Any delay on macOS is due to Apple's security verification of unsinged apps, not a gameplay issue.
